name: dataTable
description: Dynamic SLDS data table with integrated Apex wire controller, safe field query limits, error toast handling, and custom label fallbacks.

labels.shortDescription: Label shown when query returns zero records
Exception error message for invalid object or field descriptions

notes: Include <c-data-table object-api-name='Account' columns={columns} limit-count={25}></c-data-table> in any Lightning page.
Automatically installs DataTableController.cls and test suite in force-app/main/default/classes/.

name: modal
description: Accessible, SLDS-compliant modal dialog component with responsive sizing, slots, and keyboard navigation.

labels.shortDescription: Tooltip and aria-label for modal close button

notes: Use <c-modal is-open={isOpen} title='My Modal' onclose={handleClose}> to display dialogs.

contents.lwc/modal/modal.js-meta.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LightningComponentBundle xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <apiVersion>62.0</apiVersion>
    <isExposed>true</isExposed>
    <masterLabel>Modal Dialog</masterLabel>
    <description>Accessible, SLDS-compliant modal dialog component with responsive sizing, slots, and keyboard navigation.</description>
    <targets>
        <target>lightning__AppPage</target>
        <target>lightning__RecordPage</target>
        <target>lightning__HomePage</target>
    </targets>
</LightningComponentBundle>

name: toast-utils
description: Utility module wrapping ShowToastEvent with clean helper methods for dispatching toast notifications across components.
notes: Import { showToast } from 'c/toastUtils'; and invoke showToast(this, 'Success', 'Action completed', 'success');
